proposed_copy.name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
proposed_copy.setup: Rest your forearms on the pads, hold the handles and keep your back supported.
proposed_copy.execution: Brace your abs and raise your legs in front of you. Lower slowly with control and breathe out as you lift.
proposed_copy.mistake: Swinging to lift the legs. Keep the movement controlled rather than using momentum.

proposed_copy.name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
proposed_copy.setup: Place your shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the platform. Hold the handles and keep your knees straight.
proposed_copy.execution: Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower your heels below the platform for a full calf stretch. Keep a steady controlled rhythm.
proposed_copy.mistake: Bouncing or bending the knees to move the weight. Keep the knees straight and control the full range.

proposed_copy.name: Hip Thrust Machine
proposed_copy.setup: Position your upper back against the support, secure the hip pad or belt and plant both feet on the platform. Hold the handles.
proposed_copy.execution: Drive through your feet to raise your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top. Lower with control while keeping your core braced.
proposed_copy.mistake: Arching the lower back to force the hips higher. Finish by squeezing the glutes rather than leaning back.

proposed_copy.name: Assisted Pull-Up
proposed_copy.setup: Select enough assistance for controlled reps, kneel on the support pad and take the overhead handles.
proposed_copy.execution: Pull your chest up toward the handles, then lower slowly. Keep a slight bend in your elbows at the bottom and breathe out as you pull.
proposed_copy.mistake: Dropping into a dead hang or swinging. Keep the elbows slightly bent at the bottom and control the return.

proposed_copy.name: Assisted Dip
proposed_copy.setup: Select enough assistance for controlled reps, kneel on the support pad and hold the dip handles.
proposed_copy.execution: Bend your elbows to lower your body in a controlled motion, then press through the handles to rise. Keep your shoulders down and breathe out as you press.
proposed_copy.mistake: Dropping too quickly or shrugging the shoulders. Use enough assistance to keep each rep controlled.
